name: film-assistant-desktop
description: Film Assistant AI — Desktop (Windows + macOS). Shell Electron + renderer React/TipTap + camada local-first.
//: Manifesto de build do DESKTOP (AD-07: separado do package.json web/CRA). O renderer reaproveita o mesmo src/ React (build via craco). Pipeline desktop: 1) craco build (gera build/), 2) npm run shell:build (compila shell/), 3) electron-forge make.

scripts.desktop:package: npm run renderer:build && npm run shell:build && electron-forge package
scripts.desktop:make: npm run renderer:build && npm run shell:build && electron-forge make
scripts.desktop:publish: npm run renderer:build && npm run shell:build && electron-forge publish
scripts.parity:desktop: npm run renderer:build && npm run shell:build && playwright test -c parity/playwright.config.ts --project=desktop
